title: Canyon Ultimate CFR AXS positioning recheck
notes: Exact product 4071 page files Ultimate CFR under Road Bikes › Race, calls it Canyon's classic road race bike raced at WorldTour level, says it is ready for the mountains to ascend the steepest climbs, and claims one of the lightest WorldTour frames at 780 g with 33 mm tyre clearance. Manufacturer claims, not independent measurements.
